# Tempo: Plans with Friends

> Tempo is a free social planning app for iPhone. Make plans with friends, family and your partner, find a time together and fit it into everyone’s schedule. Available now on the App Store. Made by Tempo Software Pty Ltd in Brisbane, Australia.

Also known as Tempo Assistant, Tempo AI and Tempo App. Website: https://tempoassistant.com/.

## Download
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/tempo-plans-with-friends/id6779019603
- Requirements: iPhone running iOS 17.0 or later; ages 16 and over.
- Pricing: Free to download and use.
- Browser access: https://beta.tempoassistant.com/. No native Android app is currently available.

## How making plans works
- Tell Tempo what you want to do and who you want to see.
- Your Tempo works with your friends’ Tempos to compare availability and suggest a time. You can plan with one person or a group.
- Accepted plans land in everyone’s calendar. Planning settings control whether someone’s Tempo can accept automatically.
- Apple Calendar and Google Calendar connections are optional. AI planning and chat require your consent, which you can change in Settings.
- Friends see availability, not your private calendar event titles. Preferences can be shared or private.

## When to use Tempo
- Making time for a friend, planning dinner with a group, arranging a date night or catching up with family.
- Both people need a Tempo account so their Tempos can coordinate. Start by inviting someone you want to see.
- Tempo is for personal plans and time together. The website explains features and links to the app; planning happens in Tempo.

## Discover and remember
- Discover events, activities and things to do with your people.
- Keep photos, notes and ratings in your journal. Notes can be shared with the plan’s crew; photos and ratings stay private.
